elements.description:
A form the server describes: a HAL-FORMS document drawn as controls, checked by its rules, and sent as its template
asks – every type, inline and linked options, and JSON, form-encoded or query-string requests.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading; by default the template's title

properties.name: resource
properties.description: The HAL-FORMS document, when the page already has it; wins over `src`

properties.name: src
properties.description: Where to fetch the HAL-FORMS document. Also the base for relative URLs, and the target of last resort

properties.name: templateKey
properties.description: Which template to use; by default "default", else the first

properties.name: values
properties.description: The fields' values over what the template starts with. Changed by the user unless a tc-values-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: errors
properties.description: Messages for fields, by name, e.g. from the server's answer; a message goes when its field is edited

properties.name: fetcher
properties.description: Replaces fetch for every request it makes, e.g. to add auth

properties.name: labels
properties.description: Replaces any of the words: "Submit", the messages…

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-values-change
events.description: A field changed ({ values, name, value }: HalFormValuesChange); cancelable – prevented, the field keeps its value

events.name: tc-submit
events.description: The form is valid and about to send ({ method, url, headers, body, values, templateKey }: HalFormSubmit); cancelable – prevented, nothing is sent and the request is yours

events.name: tc-response
events.description: The server answered ({ ok, status, response, values }: HalFormResponse)

events.name: tc-error
events.description: Fetching the form, a field's options or the request failed ({ phase, error, name }: HalFormError)

functions.name: pickHalTemplate
functions.signature: pickHalTemplate(doc: HalFormsDocument | null | undefined, key?: string): { key: string; template: HalFormsTemplate } | null
functions.description: The template to use: the key asked for, else "default", else the first

functions.name: expandHalUri
functions.signature: expandHalUri(template: string, variables: Record<string, unknown>): string
functions.description: Expands the common URI templates (RFC 6570): {var}, {+var}, {?a,b} and {&a,b}; a variable without a value drops out

functions.name: parseHalChoices
functions.signature: parseHalChoices(raw: unknown, options: Pick<HalFormsOptions, "promptField" | "valueField">): { value: string; label: string }[] | null
functions.description: Choices from an array of plain values or objects; anything that isn't an array gives none

functions.name: parseHalCsv
functions.signature: parseHalCsv(text: string): { value: string; label: string }[]
functions.description: Choices from CSV, a line each: "value", or "prompt,value"

functions.name: buildHalRequest
functions.signature: buildHalRequest(template: HalFormsTemplate, url: string, values: Record<string, HalFormWireValue>): HalRequest
functions.description: The request a template describes, for values as they're sent

props.name: title
props.description: The heading; by default the template's title

props.name: values
props.description: The fields' values – controlled when given

props.name: defaultValues
props.description: The values on mount, over what the template starts with, when `values` isn't controlled

changelog: **HAL Form** (`tc-hal-form`) – give it a HAL-FORMS document (`resource`) or its URL (`src`) and it draws the template as controls: every `type`, `options` inline or from `options.link` (JSON or CSV), `selectedValues`, `minItems` and `maxItems`. It checks `required`, `regex`, lengths, ranges and steps when a field is left and on submit, then sends to `_htarget`, `target`, the `self` link or `src`, as JSON, form encoding or a query string. `fetcher` adds auth, cancelable `tc-submit` hands the request to the app, and `errors` shows the server's messages on fields.

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: Form association (ElementInternals)
features.why: The element's value is submitted with its form, and it takes part in form validation and reset.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: scrollbar-width
features.without: Scrollbars keep the browser's default width.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.

features.name: overscroll-behavior: contain
features.without: Scrolling past the end of a list carries on scrolling the page.
